resourceProfile.assessment: Selected Ukrainian after screening 12 common IDs across 22 remaining locales, wider systematic samples across six candidates and focused technical comparisons across four. Ukrainian showed repeated wrong-sense translations spanning electrical quantities, battery descriptions, mixing and wire design. This is sample-based selection, not a conclusive exhaustive global ranking. Canonical English, effective translations, glossary, UI code, knowledge-base articles and native Ukrainian technical references were available.
limitations: Independent model critique does not constitute competent human review.
Specialized staggered-Clapton terminology remains marked needs-review; descriptive wording is supplied.
Canonical English Joule-heating summary retains a physics wording defect; Ukrainian explicitly paraphrases intended energy conversion.
